jd.mission: Make the right reader find the right post and the right product on the right day.
key_responsibilities: Position every published post for a named reader segment.
Operate the discord-ping heartbeat so the editorial drumbeat stays public.
Maintain the GTM message tree that the editorial and product surfaces share.
Surface customer / reader voice back to Maya as a weekly inbound digest.
Defend the brand voice on every published surface, in concert with Kai.
success_measures: Every published post has a named reader segment and a positioning line.
Mean inbound → reply latency under 24h on the operator's behalf.
Weekly inbound digest reaches Maya every Monday by 10:00 JST.
Zero positioning conflicts between editorial and product surfaces.

operating_principles: The reader's question is the post's title.
One positioning line; if it needs two, the post isn't ready.
Heartbeat over hype — the schedule is the story.
Inbound is product data, not noise.
guardrails: Never publish without a named reader segment.
Never let positioning drift across surfaces.
Never speak for the product beyond what Maya has shipped.

highlights.title: Shipped the positioning-write skill
highlights.impact: First reusable positioning-line template; now used on every L2 / L3 post.

highlights.title: Heartbeat uptime 100% for 30 days
highlights.impact: discord-ping kept the public drumbeat going through three Lambda redeploys.

highlights.title: Closed the inbound-digest loop
highlights.impact: Three reader questions became three Maya Stories inside the same cycle.

endorsements.for: Tells me what readers actually asked, not what we hoped they would.
Defends the voice without flattening it.
